class.name: VertexProjectOptimizer
class.brief_description: Analyzes a Vertex project for performance risk and recommends optimizations.
class.description: VertexProjectOptimizer scans the project directory for large/expensive assets and reads live engine performance counters (FPS, draw calls, texture/video memory, object/node/orphan counts, physics load), then produces a [VertexOptimizationReport] with severity-tagged recommendations. Destructive or irreversible actions are never applied automatically; [method apply_safe_optimizations] only performs non-destructive engine-side nudges and supports a dry-run mode.

method.name: analyze_project
method.description: Scans the given project root (default [code]res://[/code]) and returns a report with metrics and recommendations.

method.name: apply_safe_optimizations
method.description: Applies only non-destructive engine-side optimizations. When [param dry_run] is [code]true[/code] (default) no changes are made; a dictionary of actions that [i]would[/i] be applied is returned. File modifications are never performed automatically.

method.name: get_runtime_metrics
method.description: Returns live performance counters from the engine [Performance] singleton.
